content.text: That worked — I'll finish the remaining clear-up orders.

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H3","instruction_en":"Move the black cable off the walkway at Hallway door and secure it along the wall.","instruction_zh":"將走廊門口的黑色電線移出走道，沿牆固定收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H4","instruction_en":"Move the cable and power strip cord off the threshold at Hallway door.","instruction_zh":"將走廊門口門檻上的電線及延長線移開並收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H5","instruction_en":"Move the cable with plug off the tiled floor in Hallway to bathroom.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室地上有插頭的電線移開走道並收好。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H6","instruction_en":"Remove the white sneakers from the walkway in Hallway to bathroom and store them in a shoe cabinet.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室走道上的白色運動鞋移開，收到鞋櫃。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H7","instruction_en":"Clear the white sneakers from the walkway in Hallway to bathroom to keep the path open.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室走道上的白色運動鞋清除，保持走道淨空。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H8","instruction_en":"Remove the blue slippers from the walkway in Hallway to bathroom.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室走道上的藍色拖鞋移開。"}

name: draft_work_order
arguments: {"hazard":"H9","instruction_en":"Clear the pair of blue slippers from the walkway in Hallway to bathroom.","instruction_zh":"將走廊往浴室走道上的一雙藍色拖鞋清除。"}
